title: Gemini fixes only the shape, so three checks and the QR code clean the answer before a person confirms it
subtitle: Example: a made-up Swisscom invoice for CHF 79.90, read under Billpod's real rules.

outcome.title: A draft the person confirms, never a bill filed on its own
lines: Bad values were dropped, not guessed, and the QR code's IBAN beat the model's. On a bill without a QR code, only the person can catch a changed IBAN.

captions.title: Send the shape with the request, not in the prompt
captions.text: The reader defines the record once, in Zod, and calls `callJson` with 4096 tokens. The gateway turns it into Gemini's `responseSchema` and sends it in the request settings.

captions.title: The provider lets the model write only tokens that fit
captions.text: Before each token, the provider removes every candidate that would break the schema. A reply that finishes normally parses, but its values may still be wrong.

captions.title: Layer one reads how the call ended
captions.text: STOP is a normal finish, MAX_TOKENS a reply cut off, SAFETY a refusal sent with HTTP 200. The gateway throws on a refusal before it parses anything, and does not retry.

captions.title: Layer two parses and checks the whole answer once
captions.text: The gateway parses the text and checks it against the same loose Zod schema, so "2026-02-30" passes here. A failure throws `LlmOutputError`, and Billpod does not retry.

captions.title: Layer three checks each value and drops what fails
captions.text: A date must exist, a currency is three letters, an IBAN must pass mod 97. `dueDate` 2026-02-30 is dropped; the IBAN passes and is kept.

captions.title: Let the exact QR code win over the model
captions.text: For every field the QR code has, its value beats the model's: `iban = qr?.iban ?? ai?.iban`. Hidden white-on-white text cannot change an IBAN the QR code carries.

captions.title: Hand a person a draft, never a bill
captions.text: The draft shows each field's source: `qr`, `ai`, `recurring` or `none`. A person confirms or corrects it. On a bill without a QR code, only the person can catch a changed IBAN.
